platform: Windows, isolated production FastAPI and SQLite, offline model and Chromium

verified_contracts.OW-01: A fenced Router closeout writes one assistant message on the original main conversation. The browser displays it and downloads the verified UTF-8 artifact from an authenticated scoped endpoint.
verified_contracts.T04: The Worker dependency gate and current goal are checked before delivery. Known failed work, an artifact integrity failure, and a missing matching verifier read each produce a partial outcome. The old candidate writes no message when the owner revises after the artifact read.
verified_contracts.T06: A durable queued closeout remains pending with dispatch disabled. An ordinary turn in the same session proceeds. Reopening with dispatch enabled commits the same closeout exactly once. A second restart preserves the same receipt and message.
verified_contracts.T10: A normal Web turn, legacy delegation, scheduling claims and historical upgrades remain supported. Downloads reject absent owner tokens and wrong sessions.
verified_contracts.T11: Superseded goal artifacts and artifacts whose source was erased cannot be downloaded. The message feed removes links invalidated by the source epoch.

offline_runs.scope: Historical migration and schema assertions, including copied tables and rollback cases
Scheduling claims, review gates, captured contexts and process-exit faults
Workbench, normal chat, main session selection, goal conflict and actual artifact download

remaining_scope: The closeout is ledger-rendered and delivers structured status and verified text artifacts.
Peer evidence references, explicit reuse across goal versions, and receipt-backed execution resumption remain under development.
The full campus assistant workflow and release acceptance remain open.
